import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset

# Filter the data for visualization: Count of dogs by breed

breed_counts.columns = ['Breed', 'Count']

# Create the bar plot

sns.barplot(x='Count', y='Breed', data=breed_counts, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title

plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds Registered in Zurich')

```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter the data for visualization: Count of dogs by breed
breed_counts = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).reset_index()
breed_counts.columns = ['Breed', 'Count']

# Create the bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Count', y='Breed', data=breed_counts, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds Registered in Zurich')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
